Thanks, that matches what I expected. The diff wraps the `date(...)` call so an invalid day now raises `ValueError("invalid date: '2024-02-30'")`, and the new test checks it. The full suite passes at 43.

Two things worth knowing:

- Because the `try` wraps the whole `int(...)` and `date(...)` expression, malformed input like `'abc-01-01'` now also gets the "invalid date" message instead of the bare `int()` error. Still a `ValueError`, so callers catching it are unaffected, but the message is broader than "impossible day."
- The test covers only the Feb 30 case. An out-of-range month (`'2024-13-01'`) takes the same path, but nothing exercises it yet. I can add that as a second case if you want it pinned.
